At BOTH left and right edges the opaque bright clear azure-blue water opening occupies y28% through y72%, centered at50%. Upper and lower low honey-colored rounded stone banks border the water; their geometry continues flush to left/right edges at the same vertical positions. Banks modestly dimensional, softly bevelled and chunky, rendered from straight above, no tall walls or side-facing architecture. Water has gentle short soft ripples and controlled blue highlights, no white glare, no waterfall, no flow arrow. It is an opaque blue water bed, not a hollow cutout. Bank texture warm light ochre stone with just a few rounded block divisions, not dense rubble.
